#### 1. epidermolysis bullosa simplex due to plakophilin deficiency  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.344)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-6809371, Reactome:R-HSA-6805567)
